stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items about safe discharge teaching for a limited-English-proficient patient with a new colostomy.
stem.zh: 阅读患者记录，并回答关于英语能力有限且新做结肠造口患者安全出院宣教的病例题。

title.en: Safe discharge teaching for a limited-English-proficient patient with a new colostomy
title.zh: 英语能力有限的新结肠造口患者安全出院宣教

summary.en: A 62-year-old Spanish-speaking woman is on postoperative day 3 after open sigmoid colectomy with end colostomy for perforated diverticulitis. She speaks and reads only Spanish. Her adult daughter speaks English and Spanish and has been interpreting at the bedside, but the chart contains no documentation of qualified interpreter use or patient teach-back. The surgeon's conditional discharge order requires the patient to demonstrate pouch emptying and wafer changing, identify concerning stoma findings, and explain when to call; caregiver participation may supplement but does not replace patient teach-back unless caregiver-dependent discharge planning is documented by the provider.
summary.zh: 一名62岁西班牙语患者因穿孔性憩室炎接受开放乙状结肠切除和末端结肠造口术后第3天。她只会说和读西班牙语。成年女儿会英语和西班牙语，并一直在床旁口译，但病历没有记录使用合格口译员，也没有记录患者本人回教。外科医生的有条件出院医嘱要求患者能演示造口袋排空和底盘更换、识别需担心的造口表现，并说明何时联系医生；照护者可参与补充，但除非医生记录为依赖照护者的出院计划，否则不能替代患者本人回教。

content.en:
Postoperative day 3 after open sigmoid colectomy with end colostomy.
History: type 2 diabetes; metformin 1,000 mg twice daily restarted this morning after adequate oral intake and creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; hypertension on lisinopril 10 mg daily; BMI 34.
Language: preferred language Spanish; speaks and reads only Spanish. No qualified interpreter use documented during admission.
Current orders: regular diet as tolerated; ambulate four times daily; saline lock; acetaminophen PRN; oxycodone PRN; wound and stoma assessments every shift; begin discharge planning today. WOC nurse consult placed postoperative day 1 but not completed.
Night note: 'Patient educated on ostomy care via daughter interpreting. Patient nodded understanding.' No teach-back documented.
Assessment: T 37.2 C, HR 78, BP 134/82, RR 16, SpO2 97% room air. Abdomen soft, mildly tender, no distension. Midline incision clean, dry, approximated with staples. Stoma round, beefy red, moist, about 3 cm diameter, protrudes about 1 cm. Two-piece cut-to-fit wafer with about 1/8-inch clearance. Pouch contains moderate thick greenish-brown stool. Peristomal skin intact. Pain 3/10 by fingers. Ambulates steadily to bathroom.
Labs: WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL; Hgb 11.4 g/dL; platelets 268 ×10³/µL; BUN 14 mg/dL; creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; K 4.0 mEq/L; Na 139 mEq/L; glucose 148 mg/dL; albumin 3.1 g/dL. No labs pending.
content.zh:
术后第3天，患者因穿孔性憩室炎接受开放乙状结肠切除和末端结肠造口。
病史：2型糖尿病；确认可经口进食且肌酐0.9 mg/dL后，今晨重新开始二甲双胍1,000 mg每日两次；高血压，服用赖诺普利10 mg每日一次；BMI 34。
语言：首选语言为西班牙语；只会说和读西班牙语。本次住院没有记录使用合格口译员。
当前医嘱：按耐受进普通饮食；每日下床活动4次；静脉留置盐水封管；对乙酰氨基酚按需；羟考酮按需；每班评估伤口和造口；今天开始出院计划。术后第1天已请造口伤口护理护士会诊，但尚未完成。
夜班记录：“通过女儿口译进行了造口护理宣教。患者点头表示理解。”未记录回教。
评估：T 37.2 C，HR 78，BP 134/82，RR 16，室内空气SpO2 97%。腹部软，切口周围轻度压痛，无腹胀。腹中线切口清洁、干燥，钉合良好。造口圆形、鲜红湿润，直径约3 cm，突出约1 cm。两件式可剪裁底盘，造口周围间隙约1/8英寸。造口袋内有中等量浓稠绿褐色粪便。造口周围皮肤完整。患者用手指表示疼痛3/10。可稳步走到卫生间。
实验室：WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL；Hgb 11.4 g/dL；血小板268 ×10³/µL；BUN 14 mg/dL；肌酐0.9 mg/dL；K 4.0 mEq/L；Na 139 mEq/L；血糖148 mg/dL；白蛋白3.1 g/dL。无待出结果。

content.en: The nurse identifies three gaps: no qualified interpreter has been used, no WOC nurse visit has occurred, and the discharge criteria require the patient's independent demonstration and explanation. The daughter offers to continue interpreting and states she will live with the patient after discharge. When the nurse asks the patient through the daughter to describe a normal stoma, the daughter answers, 'It should be red and wet,' and the patient nods. When asked directly in simple English with gestures to show pouch emptying, the patient looks to her daughter and the daughter begins guiding the patient's hands. The nurse requests a qualified Spanish interpreter, available by video within 15 minutes, and pages the WOC nurse, who can arrive by 1000.
content.zh: 护士发现三个缺口：没有使用合格口译员、造口伤口护理护士尚未会诊、出院标准要求患者本人独立演示并说明相关内容。女儿主动提出继续口译，并说出院后会与患者同住。护士通过女儿询问患者正常造口应是什么样，女儿回答：“应该是红色、湿的”，患者点头。护士用简单英语和手势直接请患者演示如何排空造口袋时，患者看向女儿，女儿开始引导患者的手。护士申请合格西班牙语口译员，视频口译15分钟内可用，并呼叫造口伤口护理护士，后者可在1000到达。

title.zh: 第2阶段：1000-1200 造口伤口护理护士宣教
口译协助下的造口宣教

content.en: The WOC nurse teaches with the qualified video interpreter. The patient asks new questions about showering, odor, and eating beans and rice. She says she has been afraid to look at the stoma and has let her daughter handle all pouch care. The WOC nurse supports a gradual first look, then guides independent pouch emptying; the patient performs it correctly on the second attempt. The patient removes the old wafer, inspects intact peristomal skin, cleans the area, and applies a new demonstration wafer with verbal coaching only. Output has increased: the pouch is emptied twice in two hours and output is thinner, yellow-green. Vitals: T 37.1 C, HR 74, BP 130/78, RR 14, SpO2 98%. Pain 2/10. Written ostomy instructions in Spanish and an insurance-compatible vendor list are provided. The nurse documents interpreter ID/language, teaching, return demonstration, and patient verbalization through the interpreter of three warning signs: stoma changes from red to dark purple or black, peristomal skin breakdown, and no output for more than 6 hours with cramping or distension.
content.zh: 造口伤口护理护士通过合格视频口译员进行宣教。患者提出新的问题：是否能淋浴、造口袋是否会有气味、是否能吃豆类和米饭。她说自己一直害怕看造口，并让女儿处理所有造口袋护理。造口伤口护理护士支持她循序渐进地第一次观察造口，然后指导她独立排空造口袋；患者第二次尝试时操作正确。患者取下旧底盘，检查完整的造口周围皮肤，清洁该区域，并仅在口头提示下贴上新的演示底盘。排出量增加：2小时内排空造口袋两次，排出物较稀、呈黄绿色。生命体征：T 37.1 C，HR 74，BP 130/78，RR 14，SpO2 98%。疼痛2/10。提供西班牙语书面造口护理说明和保险可接受的供应商清单。护士记录口译员编号/语言、宣教内容、回示演示，以及患者通过口译员说出的三个警示表现：造口由红色变成深紫色或黑色、造口周围皮肤破损、超过6小时无排出并伴腹部绞痛或腹胀。

content.en: The surgeon reviews the WOC documentation and confirms discharge criteria are met. Using the qualified interpreter, the nurse reviews medications, follow-up, diet, activity limits, when to call, and when to seek emergency care. Medications: metformin restarted; lisinopril continued; acetaminophen PRN; oxycodone prescription for five days with safe storage and disposal teaching. Follow-up: surgeon in 1 week; outpatient WOC nurse in 2 weeks. Diet: advance slowly, chew thoroughly, and introduce gas-producing foods one at a time. Activity: no lifting greater than 10 lb for 6 weeks per surgeon's order. The patient asks whether to check blood glucose at home. The nurse confirms the home glucometer is available and reviews the primary care provider's target fasting glucose range of 70-130 mg/dL. The daughter participates, but teach-back questions are directed to the patient through the interpreter. The patient correctly verbalizes warning signs, pouch emptying and changing, when to call, and the medication schedule. The nurse provides a 24-hour ostomy-support hotline and confirms two weeks of supplies. Discharge vitals: T 37.0 C, HR 76, BP 128/76, RR 14, SpO2 98%. Pain 1/10. Stoma remains red, moist, and functioning. Discharged home with daughter at 1445.
content.zh: 外科医生复核造口伤口护理护士记录，并确认已达到出院标准。护士通过合格口译员复习用药、随访、饮食、活动限制、何时联系医生以及何时急诊就医。用药：重新开始二甲双胍；继续赖诺普利；对乙酰氨基酚按需；羟考酮处方5天，并进行安全存放和处理宣教。随访：1周后外科医生复诊；2周后门诊造口伤口护理护士随访。饮食：逐步进食，充分咀嚼，一次只加入一种产气食物。活动：按外科医嘱6周内不得提举超过10磅。患者询问回家后是否测血糖。护士确认家中有血糖仪，并复习基层医生既有指示的空腹血糖目标范围70-130 mg/dL。女儿参与，但回教问题均通过口译员直接问患者。患者正确说出警示表现、造口袋排空和更换、何时联系医生以及用药时间表。护士提供24小时造口支持热线，并确认有两周用品。出院生命体征：T 37.0 C，HR 76，BP 128/76，RR 14，SpO2 98%。疼痛1/10。造口仍红润、湿润且有功能。1445与女儿一起出院回家。

stem.en: Stage 1: The daughter offers to interpret the ostomy discharge teaching. The chart shows no prior qualified interpreter use, no WOC nurse note, and no documented teach-back. What should the nurse do first?
stem.zh: 第1阶段：患者女儿主动提出为造口出院宣教做口译。病历显示此前没有使用合格口译员、没有造口伤口护理护士记录，也没有记录回教法。护士首先应怎么做？

options.en: Proceed with teaching through the daughter because she is bilingual and will live with the patient.
options.zh: 通过女儿继续宣教，因为她会说两种语言并将与患者同住。

options.en: Ask the daughter to sign the discharge instructions because she has been doing the pouch care.
options.zh: 让女儿签署出院说明，因为一直是她在照护造口袋。

options.en: Give the Spanish written instructions and document that written teaching was provided.
options.zh: 提供西班牙语书面说明，并记录已给予书面宣教。

options.en: Arrange a qualified Spanish medical interpreter before formal discharge teaching and keep the daughter present for support if the patient wants.
options.zh: 在正式出院宣教前安排合格的西班牙语医疗口译员；若患者愿意，可让女儿在场提供支持。

correct.en: Formal discharge teaching for a patient with limited English proficiency requires direct communication with the patient through qualified language assistance. The daughter may support the patient, but the case cues show she has been answering for the patient and guiding the skill rather than confirming the patient's own understanding.
correct.zh: 英语能力有限患者的正式出院宣教需要通过合格语言协助直接与患者沟通。女儿可以支持患者，但病例线索显示她一直代替患者回答并指导操作，而不是确认患者本人的理解。

byChoice.en: Written materials help reinforce teaching but do not replace interpreted discussion, teach-back, or return demonstration.
byChoice.zh: 书面材料可强化宣教，但不能替代通过口译进行的讨论、回教法和回示演示。

byChoice.en: The conditional discharge order requires the patient's demonstration and verbalization unless caregiver-dependent discharge planning is specifically documented by the provider.
byChoice.zh: 有条件出院医嘱要求患者本人演示和表述，除非医嘱明确记录为依赖照护者的出院计划。

byChoice.en: This action protects language access, preserves the patient's autonomy, and allows valid assessment of the patient's own understanding and skill.
byChoice.zh: 这一做法保障语言服务，维护患者自主权，并能有效评估患者本人是否理解并掌握技能。

byChoice.en: A willing bilingual family member is not adequate here because the daughter has been answering for the patient and the clinical stakes require accurate, patient-centered teach-back.
byChoice.zh: 在本病例中，愿意帮忙且会双语的家属不足以承担正式口译，因为女儿一直代替患者回答，而且该宣教需要准确、以患者为中心的回教确认。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a patient has limited English proficiency, do not equate family support with qualified interpretation. Ask who is demonstrating understanding: the patient or someone speaking for the patient.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到英语能力有限的患者时，不要把家属支持等同于合格口译。要判断是谁在表现理解：是患者本人，还是代替患者说话的人。

stem.en: Stage 1: Which findings show that the patient has not yet met the surgeon's discharge criteria? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第1阶段：哪些发现表明患者尚未达到外科医生规定的出院标准？选择所有适用项。

options.en: The daughter answers the normal-stoma question for the patient.
options.zh: 女儿代替患者回答正常造口表现的问题。

options.en: The only documented education was done through the daughter, with no qualified interpreter documented.
options.zh: 唯一记录的宣教是通过女儿完成，且没有记录合格口译员。

options.en: The patient nods and says brief English words that do not clearly match the questions.
options.zh: 患者点头并说简短英语词语，但这些反应与问题内容不明确匹配。

options.en: The daughter begins guiding the patient's hands during the pouch-emptying demonstration.
options.zh: 在造口袋排空演示时，女儿开始引导患者的双手。

options.en: The stoma is beefy red, moist, and protrudes about 1 cm above the skin.
options.zh: 造口呈鲜红湿润，突出皮肤约1厘米。

options.en: The patient is afebrile, hemodynamically stable, and ambulatory to the bathroom.
options.zh: 患者无发热，血流动力学稳定，并能步行至卫生间。

correct.en: The discharge order requires the patient's own demonstration of pouch emptying and wafer changing, identification of concerning stoma findings, and explanation of when to call. Lack of qualified interpreter use, unclear acquiescent responses, family-member answering, and hands-on guidance all prevent the nurse from confirming that the patient herself meets those criteria.
correct.zh: 出院医嘱要求患者本人演示造口袋排空和底盘更换、识别需担心的造口表现，并说明何时联系医生。未使用合格口译、反应含糊的附和、家属代答以及手把手引导，都使护士无法确认患者本人已达到这些标准。

byChoice.en: No qualified interpreter documentation means the nurse cannot verify language-concordant discharge teaching or the patient's own teach-back.
byChoice.zh: 没有合格口译员记录，说明护士无法确认已进行语言相符的出院宣教，也无法确认患者本人的回教结果。

byChoice.en: A red, moist, protruding stoma is an expected finding and does not show failure to meet teaching criteria.
byChoice.zh: 造口红润、湿润并突出是预期表现，并不说明宣教标准未达成。

byChoice.en: Nodding or saying 'yes' in a non-primary language is not reliable evidence of comprehension.
byChoice.zh: 用非主要语言点头或说“是”并不是可靠的理解证据。

byChoice.en: The daughter's answer is not the patient's verbalization, so it does not satisfy the stated discharge criterion.
byChoice.zh: 女儿的回答不是患者本人的表述，因此不满足医嘱中的出院标准。

byChoice.en: Stable vital signs and ambulation support physiologic readiness, but they do not prove ostomy self-care teaching criteria are met.
byChoice.zh: 生命体征稳定和能下床活动支持生理层面的出院准备，但不能证明造口自我护理宣教标准已达成。

byChoice.en: Guiding the patient's hands means independent return demonstration has not yet occurred.
byChoice.zh: 引导患者双手说明尚未完成独立的回示演示。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge-readiness items, separate physiologic stability from required teaching criteria. Stable vitals do not replace a required patient return demonstration.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做出院准备题时，要区分生理稳定与规定的宣教标准。生命体征稳定不能替代患者必须完成的回示演示。

stem.en: Stage 2: Using the qualified interpreter, the patient says she has been afraid to look at the stoma and has allowed her daughter to handle all pouch care. What is the priority nursing response before continuing skill teaching?
stem.zh: 第2阶段：通过合格口译员，患者表示她一直害怕看造口，并让女儿处理所有造口袋护理。继续技能宣教前，护士优先应如何回应？

options.en: Ask the daughter to complete the wafer change while the patient watches from bed.
options.zh: 请女儿完成底盘更换，患者在床上观看即可。

options.en: Tell the patient that the stoma looks healthy and move directly to the return demonstration.
options.zh: 告诉患者造口看起来健康，然后直接进入回示演示。

options.en: Acknowledge the fear, invite the patient to describe her concerns, and guide a gradual first look at the stoma with interpreter support.
options.zh: 承认患者的害怕感受，请她描述担忧，并在口译员协助下循序渐进地第一次观察造口。

options.en: Postpone all teaching until the outpatient WOC visit in two weeks.
options.zh: 把所有宣教推迟到两周后的门诊造口护理随访。

correct.en: The patient's avoidance is a psychosocial barrier to self-care. Brief supportive counseling and a gradual, interpreter-facilitated first look address readiness so the later pouch-emptying and wafer-change teaching can be effective.
correct.zh: 患者回避造口是自我护理的心理社会障碍。简短支持性沟通和在口译员协助下循序渐进观察造口，有助于建立准备度，使后续排空造口袋和更换底盘的教学有效。

byChoice.en: This response addresses the emotional barrier while preserving the goal of patient self-management.
byChoice.zh: 这一回应处理了情绪障碍，同时保留患者自我管理的目标。

byChoice.en: Outpatient follow-up is important, but delaying all teaching would leave the patient unprepared for immediate home care.
byChoice.zh: 门诊随访重要，但推迟所有宣教会使患者对回家后的即时护理没有准备。

byChoice.en: Having the daughter do the care reinforces dependence and does not address the patient's fear or required independent skill.
byChoice.zh: 让女儿操作会强化依赖，不能处理患者恐惧，也不能满足患者独立掌握技能的要求。

byChoice.en: Reassurance alone skips the patient's expressed fear and may worsen avoidance during the skill demonstration.
byChoice.zh: 单纯安慰跳过了患者表达的恐惧，可能在技能演示时加重回避。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a patient avoids a new body change, address readiness and coping before expecting independent technical performance.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当患者回避新的身体改变时，应先处理准备度和应对，再要求其独立完成技术操作。

stem.en: Stage 2: Classify each colostomy finding as expected for this patient's current postoperative course or requiring follow-up/escalation.
stem.zh: 第2阶段：判断每个结肠造口相关发现对该患者当前术后过程而言是预期表现，还是需要跟进/升级处理。

rows.en: Stoma is beefy red and moist.
Peristomal skin remains intact without redness or breakdown.
rows.zh: 造口周围皮肤完整，无发红或破损。

rows.en: Output is thinner and more yellow-green, and the pouch was emptied twice in two hours; vital signs are stable.
rows.zh: 排出物变稀、偏黄绿色，2小时内排空造口袋两次；生命体征稳定。

rows.en: Stoma becomes dark purple or black.
rows.zh: 造口变成深紫色或黑色。

rows.en: No stoma output for more than 6 hours with cramping or abdominal distension.
rows.zh: 超过6小时无造口排出，并伴腹部绞痛或腹胀。

rows.en: Peristomal skin develops redness and breakdown.
rows.zh: 造口周围皮肤出现发红和破损。

correct.en: The patient's red, moist stoma, intact peristomal skin, stable vital signs, and looser early postoperative output are appropriate for continued monitoring. Color change to dark purple or black, absent output with cramping or distension, or skin breakdown are warning signs that require follow-up.
correct.zh: 患者造口红润湿润、造口周围皮肤完整、生命体征稳定，以及术后早期排出物较稀，均适合继续常规观察。造口变深紫或黑色、无排出伴绞痛或腹胀、皮肤破损则是需要跟进的警示表现。

byChoice.en: A beefy red, moist stoma indicates perfused tissue in this case.
byChoice.zh: 鲜红湿润的造口提示该病例中造口组织灌注良好。

byChoice.en: Intact peristomal skin is an expected protective finding.
byChoice.zh: 造口周围皮肤完整是预期的保护性发现。

byChoice.en: Early postoperative output may become looser as bowel function returns; stable vital signs and diet tolerance support routine monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 肠功能恢复时，术后早期排出物可变稀；生命体征稳定且能进食支持常规观察。

byChoice.en: Dark purple or black color suggests impaired perfusion and requires prompt follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 深紫色或黑色提示灌注受损，需要及时跟进。

byChoice.en: Absent output with cramping or distension can indicate obstruction or another complication and requires follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 无排出并伴绞痛或腹胀可能提示梗阻或其他并发症，需要跟进。

byChoice.en: Peristomal redness and breakdown can impair pouch adherence and increase skin-injury risk.
byChoice.zh: 造口周围发红和破损会影响造口袋粘贴并增加皮肤损伤风险。

testTakingStrategy.en: Compare the finding with the whole trend. Stable vitals and functioning output make a mild output change less concerning, but color change, no output with symptoms, or skin breakdown are red flags.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将单个发现放到整体趋势中判断。生命体征稳定且造口有功能时，轻度排出物变化较不令人担心；但颜色改变、无排出伴症状或皮肤破损是危险信号。

stem.en: Stage 3: During medication reconciliation, the patient asks whether she should check blood glucose at home now that metformin has been restarted. Complete the nurse's response.
stem.zh: 第3阶段：用药核对时，患者询问现在已重新开始服用二甲双胍，回家后是否应监测血糖。完成护士的回应。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should first {{1}} and teach that metformin used alone has a {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应首先 {{1}}，并说明单独使用二甲双胍时 {{2}}。

options.en: tell the daughter to monitor and report the glucose values instead of asking the patient
options.zh: 告诉女儿代替患者监测并报告血糖值

options.en: confirm the patient's existing home glucose-monitoring plan and supplies
options.zh: 确认患者原有的家庭血糖监测计划和用品是否齐备

options.en: instruct the patient to stop home monitoring because creatinine is normal
options.zh: 因为肌酐正常，指导患者停止家庭血糖监测

options.en: low risk of hypoglycemia compared with insulin or insulin secretagogues
options.zh: 与胰岛素或促胰岛素分泌药相比，低血糖风险较低

options.en: high risk of sudden hypoglycemia that requires juice at the bedside
options.zh: 突然低血糖风险很高，需要在床边备果汁

options.en: requirement to hold lisinopril whenever fasting glucose is above target
options.zh: 只要空腹血糖高于目标值就必须停用赖诺普利

correct.en: The nurse can reinforce the patient's existing diabetes plan by confirming that the glucometer and supplies are available and reviewing the provider's target range. Metformin alone is not primarily associated with hypoglycemia; the teaching should not overstate low-glucose risk or shift responsibility away from the patient.
correct.zh: 护士可以通过确认血糖仪和耗材是否可用，并复习医嘱中的目标范围来强化患者既有糖尿病管理计划。单独使用二甲双胍通常不是低血糖的主要原因；宣教不应夸大低血糖风险，也不应把责任从患者本人转移走。

byChoice.en: The first dropdown is correct when it keeps teaching within the existing diabetes management plan and verifies the patient has supplies for home monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 第一个下拉项正确之处在于，它把宣教限定在患者既有糖尿病管理计划内，并确认患者有家庭监测用品。

byChoice.en: The second dropdown is correct when it avoids overstating hypoglycemia risk from metformin monotherapy and distinguishes metformin from insulin or insulin secretagogues.
byChoice.zh: 第二个下拉项正确之处在于，它没有夸大二甲双胍单药治疗导致低血糖的风险，并将其与胰岛素或促胰岛素分泌药区分开。

testTakingStrategy.en: Medication-reconciliation teaching should reinforce the current plan and correct the specific misconception. Do not add unrelated hold parameters or delegate the patient's self-management without need.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 用药核对宣教应强化现有计划，并纠正具体误解。不要添加无关的停药参数，也不要无必要地把患者自我管理交给他人。

stem.en: Stage 3: Which findings best support that discharge teaching has been effective and that the patient is safe to go home? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第3阶段：哪些发现最能支持出院宣教有效，且患者可以安全回家？选择所有适用项。

options.en: The nurse documents interpreter use, return demonstration, teach-back responses, supplies, and follow-up arrangements.
options.zh: 护士记录口译员使用、回示演示、回教回答、用品和随访安排。

options.en: The patient completed pouch emptying and wafer application with verbal coaching only during the WOC session.
options.zh: 在造口伤口护理护士教学中，患者仅在口头提示下完成造口袋排空和底盘粘贴。

options.en: The patient verbalizes the medication schedule and follow-up plan through the interpreter.
options.zh: 患者通过口译员说出用药时间表和随访计划。

options.en: The daughter says she understands the instructions and will take care of the pouch at home.
options.zh: 女儿说她理解说明，并会在家照顾造口袋。

options.en: Through the interpreter, the patient states the stoma warning signs in her own words.
options.zh: 通过口译员，患者用自己的话说出造口警示表现。

options.en: The patient receives written ostomy instructions in Spanish and a supply/vendor plan.
options.zh: 患者获得西班牙语书面造口护理说明以及用品/供应商计划。

correct.en: Effective discharge evaluation combines patient-centered teach-back through a qualified interpreter, return demonstration of psychomotor skills, written language-concordant reinforcement, supplies, follow-up, and complete documentation. The daughter's understanding is helpful support but does not by itself prove the patient's readiness under the stated discharge criteria.
correct.zh: 有效的出院评估应结合通过合格口译员完成的以患者为中心的回教、心理运动技能回示演示、语言相符的书面强化、用品、随访以及完整记录。女儿理解说明可作为支持，但根据本病例出院标准，单靠女儿理解不能证明患者本人已准备好。

byChoice.en: Return demonstration with only verbal coaching shows the patient can perform the needed pouching skills without hands-on family assistance.
byChoice.zh: 仅需口头提示即可回示演示，说明患者能在没有家属手把手帮助的情况下完成所需造口袋技能。

byChoice.en: Documentation of interpreter use, teach-back, return demonstration, supplies, and follow-up closes the safety and communication loop.
byChoice.zh: 记录口译、回教、回示演示、用品和随访，完成了安全与沟通闭环。

byChoice.en: Written Spanish instructions and a supply plan reduce home-care barriers and reinforce verbal teaching.
byChoice.zh: 西班牙语书面说明和用品计划可降低居家护理障碍，并强化口头宣教。

byChoice.en: The patient's own explanation through an interpreter directly evaluates comprehension of warning signs.
byChoice.zh: 患者本人通过口译员说明警示表现，直接评估了她的理解。

byChoice.en: Caregiver understanding is supportive, but it does not replace the patient's own teach-back unless caregiver-dependent discharge planning is specifically documented.
byChoice.zh: 照护者理解有帮助，但除非明确记录依赖照护者的出院计划，否则不能替代患者本人的回教。

byChoice.en: The patient's own verbalization of medications and follow-up confirms broader discharge understanding beyond ostomy technique.
byChoice.zh: 患者本人说出用药和随访安排，确认了除造口技术外更全面的出院理解。

testTakingStrategy.en: For evaluation questions, look for objective evidence that the learner or patient actually performed or explained the required skill, not just that teaching was delivered.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做评估题时，要寻找学习者或患者确实完成或说明所需技能的客观证据，而不仅是“已经宣教”。

evidenceCatalog.text: Review the client record and answer the case-study items about safe discharge teaching for a limited-English-proficient patient with a new colostomy.
阅读患者记录，并回答关于英语能力有限且新做结肠造口患者安全出院宣教的病例题。
Safe discharge teaching for a limited-English-proficient patient with a new colostomy
英语能力有限的新结肠造口患者安全出院宣教

A 62-year-old Spanish-speaking woman is on postoperative day 3 after open sigmoid colectomy with end colostomy for perforated diverticulitis. She speaks and reads only Spanish. Her adult daughter speaks English and Spanish and has been interpreting at the bedside, but the chart contains no documentation of qualified interpreter use or patient teach-back. The surgeon's conditional discharge order requires the patient to demonstrate pouch emptying and wafer changing, identify concerning stoma findings, and explain when to call; caregiver participation may supplement but does not replace patient teach-back unless caregiver-dependent discharge planning is documented by the provider.
一名62岁西班牙语患者因穿孔性憩室炎接受开放乙状结肠切除和末端结肠造口术后第3天。她只会说和读西班牙语。成年女儿会英语和西班牙语，并一直在床旁口译，但病历没有记录使用合格口译员，也没有记录患者本人回教。外科医生的有条件出院医嘱要求患者能演示造口袋排空和底盘更换、识别需担心的造口表现，并说明何时联系医生；照护者可参与补充，但除非医生记录为依赖照护者的出院计划，否则不能替代患者本人回教。
0700 initial record
0700 初始记录

Postoperative day 3 after open sigmoid colectomy with end colostomy.
History: type 2 diabetes; metformin 1,000 mg twice daily restarted this morning after adequate oral intake and creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; hypertension on lisinopril 10 mg daily; BMI 34.
Language: preferred language Spanish; speaks and reads only Spanish. No qualified interpreter use documented during admission.
Current orders: regular diet as tolerated; ambulate four times daily; saline lock; acetaminophen PRN; oxycodone PRN; wound and stoma assessments every shift; begin discharge planning today. WOC nurse consult placed postoperative day 1 but not completed.
Night note: 'Patient educated on ostomy care via daughter interpreting. Patient nodded understanding.' No teach-back documented.
Assessment: T 37.2 C, HR 78, BP 134/82, RR 16, SpO2 97% room air. Abdomen soft, mildly tender, no distension. Midline incision clean, dry, approximated with staples. Stoma round, beefy red, moist, about 3 cm diameter, protrudes about 1 cm. Two-piece cut-to-fit wafer with about 1/8-inch clearance. Pouch contains moderate thick greenish-brown stool. Peristomal skin intact. Pain 3/10 by fingers. Ambulates steadily to bathroom.
Labs: WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL; Hgb 11.4 g/dL; platelets 268 ×10³/µL; BUN 14 mg/dL; creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; K 4.0 mEq/L; Na 139 mEq/L; glucose 148 mg/dL; albumin 3.1 g/dL. No labs pending.

术后第3天，患者因穿孔性憩室炎接受开放乙状结肠切除和末端结肠造口。
病史：2型糖尿病；确认可经口进食且肌酐0.9 mg/dL后，今晨重新开始二甲双胍1,000 mg每日两次；高血压，服用赖诺普利10 mg每日一次；BMI 34。
语言：首选语言为西班牙语；只会说和读西班牙语。本次住院没有记录使用合格口译员。
当前医嘱：按耐受进普通饮食；每日下床活动4次；静脉留置盐水封管；对乙酰氨基酚按需；羟考酮按需；每班评估伤口和造口；今天开始出院计划。术后第1天已请造口伤口护理护士会诊，但尚未完成。
夜班记录：“通过女儿口译进行了造口护理宣教。患者点头表示理解。”未记录回教。
评估：T 37.2 C，HR 78，BP 134/82，RR 16，室内空气SpO2 97%。腹部软，切口周围轻度压痛，无腹胀。腹中线切口清洁、干燥，钉合良好。造口圆形、鲜红湿润，直径约3 cm，突出约1 cm。两件式可剪裁底盘，造口周围间隙约1/8英寸。造口袋内有中等量浓稠绿褐色粪便。造口周围皮肤完整。患者用手指表示疼痛3/10。可稳步走到卫生间。

Discharge-readiness review
出院准备度复核

The nurse identifies three gaps: no qualified interpreter has been used, no WOC nurse visit has occurred, and the discharge criteria require the patient's independent demonstration and explanation. The daughter offers to continue interpreting and states she will live with the patient after discharge. When the nurse asks the patient through the daughter to describe a normal stoma, the daughter answers, 'It should be red and wet,' and the patient nods. When asked directly in simple English with gestures to show pouch emptying, the patient looks to her daughter and the daughter begins guiding the patient's hands. The nurse requests a qualified Spanish interpreter, available by video within 15 minutes, and pages the WOC nurse, who can arrive by 1000.

护士发现三个缺口：没有使用合格口译员、造口伤口护理护士尚未会诊、出院标准要求患者本人独立演示并说明相关内容。女儿主动提出继续口译，并说出院后会与患者同住。护士通过女儿询问患者正常造口应是什么样，女儿回答：“应该是红色、湿的”，患者点头。护士用简单英语和手势直接请患者演示如何排空造口袋时，患者看向女儿，女儿开始引导患者的手。护士申请合格西班牙语口译员，视频口译15分钟内可用，并呼叫造口伤口护理护士，后者可在1000到达。
Stage 2: 1000-1200 WOC teaching session
第2阶段：1000-1200 造口伤口护理护士宣教
Interpreter-facilitated ostomy teaching
口译协助下的造口宣教

The WOC nurse teaches with the qualified video interpreter. The patient asks new questions about showering, odor, and eating beans and rice. She says she has been afraid to look at the stoma and has let her daughter handle all pouch care. The WOC nurse supports a gradual first look, then guides independent pouch emptying; the patient performs it correctly on the second attempt. The patient removes the old wafer, inspects intact peristomal skin, cleans the area, and applies a new demonstration wafer with verbal coaching only. Output has increased: the pouch is emptied twice in two hours and output is thinner, yellow-green. Vitals: T 37.1 C, HR 74, BP 130/78, RR 14, SpO2 98%. Pain 2/10. Written ostomy instructions in Spanish and an insurance-compatible vendor list are provided. The nurse documents interpreter ID/language, teaching, return demonstration, and patient verbalization through the interpreter of three warning signs: stoma changes from red to dark purple or black, peristomal skin breakdown, and no output for more than 6 hours with cramping or distension.

造口伤口护理护士通过合格视频口译员进行宣教。患者提出新的问题：是否能淋浴、造口袋是否会有气味、是否能吃豆类和米饭。她说自己一直害怕看造口，并让女儿处理所有造口袋护理。造口伤口护理护士支持她循序渐进地第一次观察造口，然后指导她独立排空造口袋；患者第二次尝试时操作正确。患者取下旧底盘，检查完整的造口周围皮肤，清洁该区域，并仅在口头提示下贴上新的演示底盘。排出量增加：2小时内排空造口袋两次，排出物较稀、呈黄绿色。生命体征：T 37.1 C，HR 74，BP 130/78，RR 14，SpO2 98%。疼痛2/10。提供西班牙语书面造口护理说明和保险可接受的供应商清单。护士记录口译员编号/语言、宣教内容、回示演示，以及患者通过口译员说出的三个警示表现：造口由红色变成深紫色或黑色、造口周围皮肤破损、超过6小时无排出并伴腹部绞痛或腹胀。

Stage 3: 1300-1500 discharge preparation
Final discharge review
最终出院复核

The surgeon reviews the WOC documentation and confirms discharge criteria are met. Using the qualified interpreter, the nurse reviews medications, follow-up, diet, activity limits, when to call, and when to seek emergency care. Medications: metformin restarted; lisinopril continued; acetaminophen PRN; oxycodone prescription for five days with safe storage and disposal teaching. Follow-up: surgeon in 1 week; outpatient WOC nurse in 2 weeks. Diet: advance slowly, chew thoroughly, and introduce gas-producing foods one at a time. Activity: no lifting greater than 10 lb for 6 weeks per surgeon's order. The patient asks whether to check blood glucose at home. The nurse confirms the home glucometer is available and reviews the primary care provider's target fasting glucose range of 70-130 mg/dL. The daughter participates, but teach-back questions are directed to the patient through the interpreter. The patient correctly verbalizes warning signs, pouch emptying and changing, when to call, and the medication schedule. The nurse provides a 24-hour ostomy-support hotline and confirms two weeks of supplies. Discharge vitals: T 37.0 C, HR 76, BP 128/76, RR 14, SpO2 98%. Pain 1/10. Stoma remains red, moist, and functioning. Discharged home with daughter at 1445.

外科医生复核造口伤口护理护士记录，并确认已达到出院标准。护士通过合格口译员复习用药、随访、饮食、活动限制、何时联系医生以及何时急诊就医。用药：重新开始二甲双胍；继续赖诺普利；对乙酰氨基酚按需；羟考酮处方5天，并进行安全存放和处理宣教。随访：1周后外科医生复诊；2周后门诊造口伤口护理护士随访。饮食：逐步进食，充分咀嚼，一次只加入一种产气食物。活动：按外科医嘱6周内不得提举超过10磅。患者询问回家后是否测血糖。护士确认家中有血糖仪，并复习基层医生既有指示的空腹血糖目标范围70-130 mg/dL。女儿参与，但回教问题均通过口译员直接问患者。患者正确说出警示表现、造口袋排空和更换、何时联系医生以及用药时间表。护士提供24小时造口支持热线，并确认有两周用品。出院生命体征：T 37.0 C，HR 76，BP 128/76，RR 14，SpO2 98%。疼痛1/10。造口仍红润、湿润且有功能。1445与女儿一起出院回家。
